items.description: Tenant must pay all Additional Rent to Landlord within thirty days after receiving an invoice.
items.span_text: All forms of Additional Rent payable hereunder by Tenant (aa) shall be payable to Landlord within thirty (30) days after Tenant’s receipt of an invoice for same

items.description: Tenant must pay a Late Charge and Late Payment Interest on any Late Payment, as Additional Rent.
items.span_text: Tenant shall, in addition to Tenant’s obligation to pay the Late Payment to Landlord, also be required to pay to Landlord, as Additional Rent, (i) a Late Charge, and (ii) Late Payment Interest from the Delinquency Date until the date the foregoing are paid
items.trigger: As it relates to any Late Payment

items.description: Tenant is billed directly by Landlord, as Additional Rent, for the costs of its Aggregate Direct Electric Loads.
items.span_text: Tenant shall be billed directly by Landlord as Additional Rent for the costs of Aggregate Direct Electric Loads

items.description: Tenant must pay a proportionate share of Ancillary Utility Costs based on its share of Aggregate Direct Electric Loads.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay a proportionate share of all Ancillary Utility Costs

items.anchor_event: delivery of each Generator Fuel Payment invoice
items.description: Tenant must pay each Generator Fuel Payment invoice as Additional Rent within thirty days of delivery.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay the Generator Fuel Payment to Landlord, as Additional Rent, within thirty (30) days of delivery of each Generator Fuel Payment invoice.

items.description: Landlord must keep complete books and records of all Additional Rent charges.
items.span_text: Landlord shall keep complete books and records regarding all Additional Rent charges made by Landlord hereunder.

items.anchor_event: Landlord’s confirmation of the correctness of such audit conclusions
items.description: If the Term has ended, Landlord must refund audit-identified overcharges to Tenant within thirty days after confirming the audit conclusions.
items.span_text: In the event the Term of this Lease has expired or been earlier terminated, then Tenant shall be entitled to a refund of such excess from Landlord within thirty (30) days after Landlord’s confirmation of the correctness of such audit conclusions.
items.trigger: In the event the Term of this Lease has expired or been earlier terminated

items.description: Landlord must reimburse Tenant's reasonable audit costs, up to a cap per audit, if the audit finds an overcharge above the stated threshold.
items.span_text: then Landlord shall pay to Tenant the reasonable costs and expenses of such audit, not to exceed Five Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($5,000.00) for any particular audit.
items.trigger: in the event such audit by Tenant discloses such an overcharge in excess of ten percent (10%) of the amount payable pursuant to this Lease

items.description: Tenant must pay all Taxes — Equipment before they become delinquent.
items.span_text: Tenant shall be liable for and shall pay before delinquency all Taxes — Equipment.

items.description: If Landlord elects to pay Taxes — Equipment levied against it or the Property, Tenant must reimburse its share within thirty days of demand.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay to Landlord as Additional Rent, within thirty (30) days of Landlord’s demand therefor, that part of such Taxes — Equipment for which Tenant is liable hereunder.
items.trigger: If any such Taxes — Equipment are levied or assessed against Landlord or the Property, and if Landlord elects to pay the same

items.description: Tenant must pay all Taxes — Other to Landlord as Additional Rent within thirty days of Landlord's demand.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay to Landlord, as Additional Rent and within thirty (30) days of Landlord’s demand therefor, and in such manner and at such times as Landlord shall direct from time to time by written notice to Tenant all Taxes — Other.

items.description: Tenant must use the Tenant Space only for the Permitted Use unless Landlord consents in writing.
items.span_text: Tenant shall use the Tenant Space only for the Permitted Use.
